scientific_integrity: A structural proof establishes the infinite theorem; the finite verifier is a consistency check. The general component lower bound is prior literature. Exact sharpness via the prism double-star and robustness under independent layer factorizations are the investigated additions. No external or independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The assertion is restricted to minimum proper edge colorings with one common vertical color, and all horizontal edges in each layer independently properly colored with the same remaining colors. It is not asserted for every possible minimum proper coloring of the prism or for unbalanced complete-bipartite prisms. Historical-priority comparisons are necessarily nonexhaustive.
title: Sharp wild number of properly colored complete-bipartite prisms
